provenance.sampling: All columns of every fully generated chunk within the bounded square around each saved volcanic center; no model based point selection.
notes: Each column row is [block_x, block_z, highest_non_air_y, block_id, exact_surface_lava, saved_quart_biome_at_surface].
Lava means the actual highest non-air saved block is minecraft:lava; it does not infer exposed magma below snow or rock.
No Minecraft launch, chunk generation or save writes.
